findings.customer_counter: One canonical warm timber serving table: thick rounded plank top; four legs with rails/lower shelf; black register fixed to one tabletop end in accepted turnaround; screen/keypad faces staff rear, register back faces customer front. Retain broad clear stock and handoff surface. Gameplay images confirm staff inside the camp, customers outside and green cash collecting behind the counter.
findings.counter_variants: A24 shows two repeated instances of the same timber/register service counter serving two queues. A9 shows a roadside/car-service placement using the same basic counter. B8 shows timber stock, A9/A24 show food service. These establish use states and placement repetition, not distinct base designs.
findings.processing_exclusion: Blue metal three-part workstation with silver input/output trays and central orange grille. A16 depicts it beside processing staff and connected to conveyor/food output upstream of customer counters. It is not an extra customer-counter variant.
findings.plot_exclusion: 29-buy-counter-action.png is a flat painted purchase/action ground plot with counter icon and example price600, not a physical counter asset.
findings.fence_identity: Original supplied pixels: dense substantial rounded warm timber logs with varying pointed snow caps; two horizontal structural rails; crossed cream rope lashings repeated around logs/rails; continuous grounded rhythm. Latest gray-studio style governs finish and presentation, not the old runtime context.
findings.gate_identity: Original supplied pixels: two open solid timber leaves with layered planks, perimeter frames and diagonal/X bracing; snow on upper rail, substantial rope-bound pointed snow-capped posts, continuing fence sections and clear threshold.
